purpose: Exploratory screen of fixed routes conditional on coarse source-region alarms; no field guarantee
regions: Four spatial quadrants cut at median node x and median node y separately in each network; illustrative alarm regions, not actual monitored sectors
sources: 8 design and 8 held-out distinct uniformly sampled candidate nodes per region, fixed seed 20261027; excludes exits and inserted A; no accident probabilities
screen: All non-exit origins except any sampled source; dry-shortest-route worst design-source deadline. Select at most 12 with deadline in [0,3600) per region using fixed seed, not optimization outcomes. Report initially infeasible separately.
objective: Maximize min latest departure across design sources for one common path, with length <= (1+budget) dry shortest length; capped at 3600 s
evaluation: Same stored route on every held-out source, without selecting route using actual source. Baseline route tie broken deterministically.
limitations: Old volume-transfer hazard proxy, average tunnel depth, uncalibrated speeds and synthetic regions. Held-out scenario minimum is a stress test, not a continuous-region guarantee. Selection uses design fields only.
